title: All-ones test in polynomial time
statement: The function sending a bit string $x$ to the one-bit word whose bit is $1$ exactly when every bit of $x$ is $1$ is polynomial-time computable. The condition includes the empty word, for which the output bit is $1$.
replaced: The function sending a bit string $x$ to the single bit that is $1$ if $x$ consists only of ones (that is, $x = 1^{|x|}$, the empty word included) and $0$ otherwise is polynomial-time computable.
